usage: 1. 刷牙  (caat3 ngaa4) is used as a verb phrase meaning 'to brush teeth.'
2. It can be used in present continuous tense, e.g., 我而家刷牙 (I'm brushing my teeth).
3. To make it negative, add 唔 (m4) before the verb, e.g., 我唔刷牙 (I don't brush my teeth).
4. To ask a question, add 呀 or 嗎 at the end, e.g., 你刷牙未呀? (Have you brushed your teeth?).
5. It can be combined with expressions of time, e.g., 早晨刷牙 (brushing teeth in the morning).

examples.meaning: I brush my teeth every morning.
Have you brushed your teeth yet?
